# Lorem Studio

> Lorem Studio is a photography studio based in [City, State] that creates portrait, landscape and documentary photography, told as a story. Available for travel.

## Services
- Portrait sessions: individuals, couples and families, on location or in natural-light studios.
- Weddings and events: documentary coverage of the whole day.
- Brand and commercial: headshots, products and workspaces for small businesses and creatives.
- Fine art prints: limited-edition landscape prints on archival paper.

## Booking
- Portraits: book 2 to 4 weeks ahead. Weddings: 6 to 12 months ahead.
- Delivery: portrait galleries within 2 weeks; wedding galleries within 6 weeks (sneak peek within 72 hours).
- Contact: hello@example.com or the form at https://www.example.com/#contact
